lemma cheaper (h:∀ i,F.coeffSize (Size.axis F i-X i) ≤ sliver F): ∃ V:F.Coeff≃ₗ[ℂ] F.Coeff, (∀ i,V i=decor F X i)∧ ∀ i, F.coeffSize (V.symm i) ≤ 2*F.coeffSize i:=by
    let T:= decor F X; let z:= Size.axis F; let c:=orbitCost F; have hc:0<c:= zero_lt_one.trans_le (orbitCost_one_le _)
    have he (i): F.coeffSize i ≤ 2*F.coeffSize (T i):=by
       have hs: i - T i=(∑ j:Motion.Tally F, chips F i j • Motion.patch F j.1 (z j.2-X j.2)):=by
           conv_lhs=> lhs; rw [← show repaint F z i=i from repaint_same F LinearMap.id (fun v m=> rfl) i]; unfold repaint
           simp_rw [patch_sub,smul_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; rfl
       have hp : F.coeffSize (i-T i) ≤ F.coeffSize i/2:=by
           rw [hs]; apply (Size.finite F _ _).trans; let p:=sliver F
           have hA(j:Motion.Tally F): F.coeffSize (chips F i j • Motion.patch F j.1 (z j.2-X j.2)) ≤ ‖chips F i j‖ * (orbitCost F*p):=by
              rw [Size.smul]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((patch_cost ..).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h j.2) hc.le)) (norm_nonneg _)
           apply le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _=> hA j)); rw [←Finset.sum_mul]; apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (chipcost F i) (mul_nonneg hc.le (sliver_pos F).le)).trans_eq; unfold c sliver; unfold c at hc; field_simp
       have hv := Work.G08.size_triangle F i (T i); linarith only [hv,hp]
    exact ePack F T he

proof_context.conclusion: If each basis image X i is within sliver F of the basis vector, then |i - T i| <= |i|/2, so T = decor F X is a linear equivalence with |T^{-1} i| <= 2|i|.

lemma solaris {b:ℕ→ℝ}(he: Braze (C:=C) V b): ∃ E P U,Hearth (C:=C) V ζ E P U:=by
    let Y(i):= sphere (S! i) ((X).card) (b i); let Z(i):= storms (BasisCost.price V) (BasisCost.price (T)) C i d; let hE(i):=Real.exp (((K i).supportExponent+2)*81); let E(i):= 4*(1+(S! i|>.columns))*Y i+hE i*Z i*ζ d i*(u i)⁻¹
    have hw : ∀ᶠ N:ℕ in atTop, ∀ p:ℕ,∃ V':C.label d≃ₗ[ℂ] C.label d,∃ Z': (C.labels.level d).Index → C.label d, (∀ i:C.label d,V' i=decor F Z' i)∧(∀ i,(F).coeffSize (V'.symm i)  ≤  2*(F).coeffSize i)∧ ∀ j,matter V N p Z' j ζ E:=by
       have hP:= (eventually_all_finset (X)).mpr (fun (x : Cover) (_:x∈X)=> eventually_all.mpr fun i:Axis=> Mark.lengths C.S (20*((x i).natAbs+1)))
       filter_upwards [sanded hG C d (BasisCost.price V) (BasisCost.price (C.localSection d)) (zero_le_one.trans (BasisCost.price_pos _)) (zero_le_one.trans (BasisCost.price_pos _)),cover_tops (C:=C) hG X,mitt (C:=C) hG X, hP,he.arc,he.flight,he.hymns,eventually_gt_atTop (C.ref d)] with i ht hh hi hL hA hB hb hx p
       have hlx(j:(C.labels.level d).Index):∃ w:C.label d,(F).coeffSize (Size.axis F j-w) ≤ sliver F∧∀ k m:ℕ,C.ref d  ≤  k→k < i→Stock.Tabs.opens C.path.levels 1 m k→∀ a:Motion,∀ hm:m  ≤  i,(center C.S p hm 0).rootTest (C.beta i p) (dance a (initial V C.path i p (Size.axis F j) 0-initial (T) C.path i p w 0))  ≤  cider C ζ d m k*E i*RelayDifference.flight C (-RelayDifference.gamma) (i,p):=by
          obtain ⟨Y',t',hc',hz⟩:= inviting V hV H hx.le (p:=p) (fun v hv j=> hL v hv j p) hA hb.1 u ζ (hF.candle i) (h.grows _ _ hx.le).le (Classical.choice (hF.full i p)) ⟨hi p,hh p⟩ ht j
          obtain ⟨v,hv,hT⟩:= figment C i p d B W u ψ φ δ ζ r D H h (initial V C.path i p (Size.axis F j) 0) Y' (Y i) t' (E i) hx hc'; rw [hz] at hv; exact ⟨_,le_of_mul_le_mul_left (hv.trans hB) (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (C.S.block (i-1)).property) _), fun k m hi ht hb a hm=> hT m k hi ht hb a hm⟩
       choose t he hT using hlx; obtain ⟨V',hV,ht⟩:= cheaper F t he; exact ⟨V',t,hV,ht,hT⟩
    let candle (N p:ℕ)(V':C.label d≃ₗ[ℂ] C.label d)(Z': (C.labels.level d).Index→ C.label d):Prop:=(∀ i:C.label d,V' i=decor F Z' i)∧ (∀ i,(F).coeffSize (V'.symm i)  ≤  2*(F).coeffSize i)∧ ∀ j,matter V N p Z' j ζ E
    have hh (N p:ℕ):∃ V' Z',(∃ v f,candle N p v f)→candle N p V' Z':=by by_cases h:∃ v f,candle N p v f; obtain ⟨v,f,h⟩:=h; exact ⟨v,f,fun _=>h⟩; exact ⟨LinearEquiv.refl ℂ _,fun _=>0,fun he=>(h he).elim⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Eventually in N and for every p, the basis matches from inviting and figment give V' = decor F Z' with coeffSize(V'^{-1} i) <= 2 coeffSize i and the matter (local error) bounds, collected in Hearth.
